name: campus-connect
description: Campus Connect — College-verified student social & networking app

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix apps/admin install && npm --prefix apps/student install && npm --prefix backend/functions install
scripts.build: npm run build:functions && npm run build:admin && npm run build:student
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,storage 'cd backend/functions && npm run test:rules'
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/admin run lint && npm --prefix backend/functions run lint && npm run lint:student

author: Campus Connect Team
